operators.name: unbind_dim1
semantics: Splits input tensor along dimension 1 into 32 tensors, each a view with stride [524288, 128, 1].
Returns a tuple (Python tuple) of tensors in order.
Does not copy data; each tensor shares storage with input.

operators.name: identity_new_tensor
semantics: Returns a new tensor with the same data but contiguous (stride [16384, 128, 1]).
Copies data from input; equivalent to pixel_shuffle with upscale_factor=1 producing a new tensor.

operators.name: stack_dim1
semantics: Stacks the given tensors along a new dimension 1.
Each input tensor becomes a slice at position along dim=1.
Output shape is [512, 32, 128, 128] with stride [524288, 16384, 128, 1] (contiguous).
Input tensors are expected to be contiguous (each [512,128,128]).
Split x along dim=1 into 32 tensors; result is a Python tuple.
Each tensor is a view with shape [512,128,128] and stride [524288,128,1].
Order is preserved from original dimension 1.
Apply PixelShuffle(upscale_factor=1) to each tensor in the tuple.
PixelShuffle with factor 1 is identity, but creates a new contiguous tensor for each item (stride [16384,128,1]).
Result is a Python list of 32 tensors.
Element order corresponds to original dim=1 order.
Stack the list of tensors along a new dimension 1.
Each list element becomes a slice; order preserved.
Return the stacked tensor (same as step_003).
